The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8a815e7845436e07), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 40-41. statement: For a sufficiently small fixed ϑ > 0, the periodic effective background HN j satisfies ‖ ‖ ‖HN j ‖ ‖ ‖ rj ≤ C|λ|γj , (6.13) ‖ ‖ ‖HN j − ΠN hj ‖ ‖ ‖ rj ≤ C|λ|γj exp(−cN/rj), (6.14) 40 whenever rj ≤ ϑN. The constants and the coupling interval are independent of N, j. On every fixed finite set of scales, coefficients in a fixed plane chart converge to their plane counterparts as N → ∞, with the tails interpreted in the weighted list norms. For real λ these backgrounds are real. At every finite volume the successive maps, including the preliminary map, retain the exact partition identity with their scalar prefactors, and the residual tilt defines a positive Gibbs probability.
